service.description: Internal: the records a message links to, for its record cards: each /qapps link in its body whose query names a record id (workEffortId, requestId, partyId, orderId, invoiceId, paymentId, shipmentId, productId, facilityId, assetId, communicationEventId), up to five, as [{entity, id}]. The card checks, for each reader, that the reader may see the record.

A task, request or event made from a chat message (the message actions, design §13 MessageActions): mantle.party.CommunicationServices.create#RecordFromChatMessage names it from the message's first line, files the message on it as a communication event, and in a record room links it to that record; it checks that the user may read the room (a message removed, or of a room the user may not read, is "not found") and refuses a message of an end-to-end encrypted room, whose text the server does not have. Out: the new record, its Commons link (url, null when Commons has no screen for it) and a message for the user.

parameter.name: emailMessageId
parameter.description: Sales P5: a mail message, for kind lead (Mail's message-actions)

parameter.name: communicationEventId
parameter.description: Sales P5: an internal message, for kind lead

parameter.name: kind
parameter.description: lead (Sales P5, "Create lead": the sender's inquiry as a lead of the user's, from a chat, mail or internal message, ironstone.sales.ContextServices.create#LeadFromMessage), task, request, event or case (Customer Service P6: a case for the customer who sent it, ironstone.customerservice.ChannelServices.create#CaseFromMessage), or claimLine (People P15, "Add to my claim": the caller's own message as a draft line of their expense claim, mantle.humanres.ExpenseServices.create#ClaimLineFromChat), or application (People P16, "Create application": the sender's job application to the room's opening or a named plus tag, a recruiter's, mantle.humanres.RecruitingServices.create#ApplicationFromChat)

service.description: The external-conversation provider of IronStone's Comms root (plans/archive/Comms-Framework.md §3.3): the first text of a new outside number is filed on the one party the user may see with that number (get#CallContext's match), as File on a record files a message (file#OnRecord: a communication event on the party's Chatter). No party, or more than one, files nothing (filed false), and a later text tries again. The communication event is made once per message, so the same idempotencyKey again does not file it twice.

File a chat message on a record (the message actions' File on a record): the message as a communication event (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.findOrCreate#ChatCommunicationEvent, which checks that the user may read the room and refuses a message of an end-to-end encrypted room) linked to the record (link#CommunicationEventRecord, which checks that the user may see the record), so the record's Chatter shows it. Out: the record's title and Commons link.

actions.script: const info = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.get#RecordInfo').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntityName, recordId: recordId, requireVisible: true}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const found = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.CommunicationServices.findOrCreate#ChatCommunicationEvent').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, eventSeq: eventSeq}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return communicationEventId = found.communicationEventId ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.CommunicationServices.link#CommunicationEventRecord').parameters({communicationEventId: communicationEventId, recordEntityName: info.info.recordEntityName, recordId: recordId, recordUrl: info.url || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return title = [info.typeLabel, info.title].filter((part) => part).join(' ') url = info.url || null
